title: Your Outdoor Living Lead Engine: 60-Minute GHL and Claude Review

sections.label: 1 - WORKFLOW REVIEW (20 MIN)
sections.note: Your intake/lead-routing workflow, then the 8 follow-ups: speed-to-lead, consult reminders, proposal chase, nurture, reactivation, reviews and referrals. 9 workflows in 20 minutes is about 2 minutes each, so we go straight to triggers, branching, timing and routing.

sections.label: 2 - CLAUDE STRATEGY (15 MIN)
sections.note: Claude already reads and writes your contacts, tags and opportunities through the API/MCP connector. Anything on a clock stays native in GHL (workflows, webhooks, custom actions, AI steps); anything that needs judgment across your data goes to Claude through the API. To monitor, audit and maintain the system over time, Claude runs the section 3 check on a schedule you set, and a lead it finds outside every workflow gets the tag that starts the right one.

sections.label: 3 - TESTING AND REPORTING (15 MIN)
sections.note: Your two silent failures: empty merge fields and leads that never enter a workflow. The first is caught inside GHL before the send, the second by a missing entry tag.

sections.label: 4 - NEXT STEPS (10 MIN)
sections.note: The prioritized list of improvements to make, in writing after the call. If Buildertrend should get won jobs from your sales pipeline, it goes on the list as its own item.
